answer: A yarrow bond ties every agent identity to a refundable stake that only unlocks after a glacier-slow vesting period: to trade, an agent locks collateral, and verified fraud burns the stake and revokes its reputation, so each fake identity costs real money and months of waiting. Sybils cannot echo cheaply through the market, because every new persona must pay the same price again, while honest agents earn the deposit back with interest from completed work.
